title: Keyboard Wizard CE
description: Keyboard Wizard CE lets you edit key configurations more visually.
body:
Keyboard Wizard CE is a client-side key binding management mod designed to help players find, organize, and fix key binding conflicts in Minecraft more easily.
It provides a visual keyboard interface where players can see which actions are assigned to each key at a glance. Color highlights make it easy to identify unbound keys, normal bindings, and conflicting bindings. The mod also supports searching, category filtering, switching between main keyboard / numpad / auxiliary layouts, and rebinding keys directly from the on-screen keyboard.
## Main Features
- Visual keyboard interface for checking key bindings at a glance
- Highlights key binding conflicts for quick troubleshooting
- Search and category filters, especially useful for large modpacks
- Rebind keys directly by clicking the on-screen keyboard
- Clear or reset individual bindings, with support for resetting all bindings
- Multiple layouts: main keyboard, numpad, and auxiliary keys
- Opens with F7 by default
- Adds a shortcut entry to the vanilla Controls screen
- Client-side only; no server installation required


按键精灵社区版（Keyboard Wizard CE） 是一款客户端按键绑定管理模组，主要用于帮助玩家快速查找、整理和修复 Minecraft 中的按键冲突。
它提供了一个直观的可视化键盘界面，玩家可以直接在屏幕键盘上查看每个按键当前绑定了哪些功能，并通过颜色提示快速识别未绑定、正常绑定和冲突绑定。模组还支持按分类筛选、搜索按键绑定、快速清除或重置绑定，让处理大量模组带来的按键冲突变得更简单。
## 主要功能
- 可视化键盘界面，直观看到各按键绑定情况
- 高亮显示按键冲突，快速定位重复绑定
- 支持搜索和分类筛选，方便在大量按键绑定中查找目标
- 支持直接点击键盘按键进行重新绑定
- 支持清除、重置单个绑定，以及一键重置全部绑定
- 支持主键盘、数字键盘、辅助按键等多种布局
- 可通过默认快捷键 F7 打开界面
- 在原版控制设置界面中提供快捷入口
- 纯客户端模组，不需要服务端安装
